title: Case: Resident at 3 Sedge Lane writes about a box shown as delivered three days earlier
context: The desk's inbox for the week covers several shipments. DL-933 for Mrs Havercroft at 3 Sedge Lane shows delivered on 7 July.
initial_request: Your tracking says my box came on Tuesday. It is now Friday. The lad next door spotted it this morning from his side, round by the garage door. I cannot see that door from inside the house and I do not go round there. I am eighty-four and on a frame. I don't drive, so that garage stays shut for days. The box is still sat there now because he was off to work and I can't lift it or carry it. I told your people all this LAST MONTH. Same thing, same spot. I can barely get a box in through the front door when it is put ON the step. Front door. Every time. I don't want a sorry. I want it written down somewhere so it stops happening. Dot

events.body: DL-905 (Havercroft, 3 Sedge Lane). Box was left at the garage side door on 16 Jun and the resident could not get to it. Driver re-attended 18 Jun and carried it to the front door. One-off. For your notes: resident is in her eighties, uses a walking frame, does not drive, and the garage is not opened for days at a time. If she wants front door only on every delivery, that is a standing delivery note on the address. Dispatch adds those on request through Dispatch chat. Nobody has asked us to.

Your summer catalogue has landed! Garden lighting, picnicware and 3-for-2 on storage tubs until the end of the month. You are receiving this because you are a trade contact. Unsubscribe | View in browser
DL-960, one pallet of garden benches, is on the floor waiting for the forklift, which is back from service Wednesday. Nothing needed from the desk, just so you know if the consignee rings.
Thanks, Thursday works for DL-949. Cheers.
DL-933 delivered 7 Jul 13:05, 3 Sedge Lane. Driver note: 'no answer at door, left side of property by garage'. Photo on file shows the box against the garage side door.
AUTOMATIC REPLY. Scheduling is handling a high volume of requests. We aim to reply within two working days. Please do not send the same request twice.
Your June statement for the Rivet Delivery Desk account is ready to view on the Business portal. This mailbox is not monitored.
Update on DL-949, driver actually came Wednesday not Thursday but I was in anyway so no harm done. All received.
Notice: warehouse closed Monday 13 Jul for stocktake. Orders placed after Friday noon dispatch Tuesday. Kind regards, Warehouse dispatch. Please consider the environment before printing this message.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask Dispatch to re-attend and move DL-933 from the garage side door to the front door, and to add a standing front-door-only delivery note for 3 Sedge Lane.

must: Asks Dispatch to re-attend 3 Sedge Lane and bring DL-933 from the garage side door to the front door, saying it has been outside since 7 July and she cannot retrieve it
Asks Dispatch to add a standing front-door-only delivery note on the address, pointing to the same thing happening with DL-905 on 16 June
Tells Dispatch she is eighty-four, uses a walking frame, cannot see or reach the garage door and cannot lift the box, so the re-attendance is prioritised
must_not: Confirms to her that DL-933 was delivered to the property and treats the case as closed
Asks her, or tells her to ask her neighbour, to fetch or move the box
Asks only for a one-off re-attendance and leaves out the standing delivery note
Tells her a driver will come at a stated time, or that the standing note is in place, before Dispatch confirms it
Sends her a stock apology or a tracking confirmation in place of getting the box moved
expected.reference_message: DL-933, 3 Sedge Lane (Mrs Dorothy Havercroft). Delivered 7 Jul 13:05, left against the garage side door per the driver's note and photo. It is still there today, 10 Jul. She is eighty-four, uses a walking frame, cannot see that door from inside the house, does not go round to it and cannot lift or carry the box. Two requests. (1) Please re-attend and carry the box to her front door, as you did for DL-905 on 18 June; tell me when it is booked. (2) Please add a standing delivery note on the address: front door only, never the garage or side of the property. This is the second time in a month it has been left in the same spot, and you told me on 18 June that a standing note needs a request through this chat. This is that request. Please confirm when the note is on the address.

rationale: Most of the week's inbox is other shipments, auto-replies and newsletters. Three events matter: Dispatch's 18 June note about the resident and how a standing delivery note is requested, the 7 July scan showing the box left at the garage again, and her message that it is still there. A tracking-led reply would call it delivered; the right message gets the box moved and asks for the standing note she was never given.

review.note: Coordinator asked Dispatch on Dispatch chat for the re-attendance and the standing front-door note, matching the key.
